Serve a corpus as an OpenAlex-compatible API

Source: R/routes.R
serve_corpus.Rd

Prepares the corpus (see prepare_corpus()) and serves it like the OpenAlex API, so openalexPro::pro_query(endpoint = "http://127.0.0.1:8000") and the download functions of openalexPro work against it unchanged:

Usage

serve_corpus(
  corpus,
  port = 8000L,
  host = "127.0.0.1",
  api_key = NULL,
  root = "https://api.openalex.org",
  block = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

corpus

Directory with the corpus Parquet files.

port, host

Where to serve. The default host is only reachable from this computer; another host makes the corpus (and translation with api_key) available to the network.

api_key

OpenAlex API key for translation requests that bring none. Not needed: translation is free.

root

The OpenAlex API used for translation.

block

Block the R session while serving.

...

Passed to prepare_corpus().

Value

The plumber2 api object, invisibly.

Details

  • GET /works?filter=...&sort=...&per_page=...&cursor=..., also with group_by= (one dimension; :include_unknown shows works without a value as the group unknown)

  • GET /works/{id} (any ID form, or a DOI)

  • GET /?oql=... and GET /?oqo=..., POST / with oqo or oql and the view parameters select, sort, per_page, page, cursor

  • POST /query: forwarded to OpenAlex (translation)

  • GET /corpus: what is served (filters, group_by columns)

  • /: a web page for running queries in the browser (/app)

Classic URLs and OQL are translated to OQO by OpenAlex's free /query endpoint (the network is needed, no credits are spent); an OQO runs fully offline. Requests are handled one at a time.
